title: Sum Line Counts Across Changes
description: Aggregates insertions and deletions, tracking uncountable files separately.
signature: export function sumLineCounts(changes: readonly GitFileChange[]): { insertions: number; deletions: number; uncounted: number }
returns: { insertions: number; deletions: number; uncounted: number }
semantics: Sums countable changes and counts files with null counts separately.
